description: Corrected the critical initialization mapping bug in the `GPT` class where the `Block` class variables (`self.x`, `self.x0`) were incorrectly passed to the MLP layers during the forward pass instead of the forward pass parameters (`self.x`, `self.x0`). This caused the `MuonAdamW` optimizer to crash on the first step due to passing uninitialized tensors to the `Block` class, leading to a val_bpb drop from 0.9910 to 0.9900.
